title: Mistake #1: why your boards keep coming out short

slides.title: Your boards keep coming out short?
slides.sub: Every cut eats about ⅛" of wood

slides.label: Mistake #1
slides.heading: Cutting down the middle of the line
slides.body: A typical saw blade removes a slot about ⅛" wide. Cut on the center of your pencil line and part of that slot comes out of the piece you wanted. Do it on every part and the box won't close.

slides.label: The fix
slides.heading: Cut on the waste side
slides.body: Put an X on the scrap piece. Line up the blade on the X side of the line, so the line is still on your part after the cut.
slides.fix: Mark the X before every cut.

slides.heading: 3 quick checks
items: Use the same tape measure for every part.
Cut one piece, measure it, then cut the rest.
Same-length parts? Clamp a stop block. No new marks.
slides.tip: Let the blade stop fully before you lift it or grab the offcut.
